markAll.label: Mark all read
markAll.aria: {count, plural, one {Mark the 1 unread message read} other {Mark all # unread messages read}}
markAll.ariaFresh: {count, plural, one {Mark the 1 message new since you were here as read} other {Mark all # messages new since you were here as read}}
markAll.done: Marked {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} read

ohbox.title: Ohbox
ohbox.newSinceTitle: {count, plural, one {# message since this came back} other {# messages since this came back}}
ohbox.olderShowing: {count, plural, one {1 older message} other {# older messages}} from your server.
ohbox.olderEnd: That is everything on your server.
ohbox.olderFailed: Older mail could not be loaded. {reason}
ohbox.protectedPreview: Verification code — kept out of AI
ohbox.resurfaceSkipNote: {horizon} lands at {booked} — the clocks skip {asked} that night.
ohbox.rowDoneAria: Done — stops resurfacing and files under Earlier
ohbox.rowDoneScheduledAria: Done — cancels the return and files under Earlier
ohbox.refusedOrganized: Nothing changed — {name} organizes this mailbox, so piles and returns are set where it runs.
ohbox.refusedOrganizedUnknown: Nothing changed — piles and returns are set where the install that organizes this mailbox runs.
ohbox.refusedNobody: Nothing changed — nothing organizes this mailbox. Settings → Mailboxes has the button to organize it here.
ohbox.pressQueuedOrganized: Queued for {name} — it happens on the next pass.
ohbox.pressQueuedOrganizedUnknown: Queued for the organizer — it happens on the next pass.
ohbox.pressPartlyRefused: {count, plural, one {1 message did not change} other {# messages did not change}}.
ohbox.pressPartlyQueued: {count, plural, one {1 message is queued for the organizer} other {# messages are queued for the organizer}}.
ohbox.toastUndoExpired: Too late to undo — that has already been sent.
ohbox.refusedPress: Nothing changed — that did not go through. Try it again.
ohbox.deleteNote: It moves to the Trash folder on your own mail server — ohmail never erases mail. Your mail server's Trash rules apply from there.
ohbox.deleteFailed: That delete could not be saved — the message is where it was.
ohbox.deleteNoTrash: Not deleted — this mailbox has no Trash folder, and ohmail never erases mail.
ohbox.deleteUndone: Not deleted — the message is where it was.
ohbox.toastDeletedMany: {count, plural, one {Moved to Trash.} other {# messages moved to Trash.}}
ohbox.deleteUndoneMany: {count, plural, one {Not deleted — the message is where it was.} other {Not deleted — # messages are where they were.}}
ohbox.deleteUndoneLeftMany: {count, plural, one {Not deleted.} other {# messages not deleted.}}
ohbox.deleteFailedMany: {count, plural, one {That delete could not be saved — the message is where it was.} other {# of those deletes could not be saved — the messages are where they were.}}
ohbox.deleteQueuedMany: {count, plural, one {1 message is} other {# messages are}} queued for the organizer — they are deleted on its next pass.
ohbox.deleteReplayRetrying: {count, plural, one {Deleting that message did not finish. Retrying…} other {Deleting # messages did not finish. Retrying…}}
ohbox.deleteReplayFailed: {count, plural, one {That delete could not be completed — the message is where it was.} other {# of those deletes could not be completed — the messages are where they were.}}
ohbox.bulkDeleteAsk: {count, plural, one {Delete this message?} other {Delete # messages?}}
ohbox.toastDownloadAllFailed: Those files couldn't be fetched from your mailbox. Try one at a time.
ohbox.toastSavedToDownloads: {count, plural, one {Saved to Downloads} other {# files saved to Downloads}}
ohbox.toastSaveNoDownloads: This computer has no Downloads folder set, so nothing was saved.
ohbox.toastSaveRefused: {count, plural, one {The file could not be saved.} other {# files could not be saved.}}
ohbox.doorbell: {count, plural, =0 {All clear} one {1 waiting} other {# waiting}}
ohbox.doorbellAria: {count, plural, =0 {All clear, nobody waiting — open the Screener} one {1 first-time sender waiting — open the Screener} other {# first-time senders waiting — open the Screener}}
ohbox.doorbellNotYetAria: Not organizing yet: first-time senders go straight to the Ohbox — set up organizing
ohbox.doorbellHandedBackAria: Handed back: nothing organizes this mailbox, so first-time senders go straight to the Ohbox — open Mailboxes to organize it here
ohbox.doorbellNotOrganizingAria: Not organizing: nothing organizes this mailbox, so first-time senders go straight to the Ohbox — open Mailboxes
ohbox.doorbellNotOrganizingSome: {count, plural, one {Not organizing {address}} other {Not organizing # mailboxes}}
ohbox.doorbellNotOrganizingSomeAria: {count, plural, one {Nothing organizes {address}: its first-time senders go straight to the Ohbox} other {Nothing organizes # of your mailboxes: their first-time senders go straight to the Ohbox}}
ohbox.connectLead: Mail arrives here once ohmail can read a mailbox. Nothing moves until you say so.
ohbox.emptyScreenerHint: {count, plural, one {1 first-time sender is} other {# first-time senders are}} waiting in the Screener. Nothing reaches the Ohbox until you say yes.
ohbox.emptyFiledHint: {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} arrived and none of it belongs here. Try News, Receipts or Search.
ohbox.emptyRestHint: Pick a message with <kbd>j</kbd> or a click — it opens here.
ohbox.emptyRestHintTouch: Pick a message — it opens here.
ohbox.pickedAria: {count, plural, one {1 selected — clear the selection} other {# selected — clear the selection}}
ohbox.keySelLater: Queue the selection for the Reply Run
ohbox.actionMarkReadCount: Mark {count, plural, one {1 unread message} other {# unread messages}} as read
ohbox.toastBulkRead: {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} marked read.
ohbox.toastBulkUnread: {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} marked unread.
ohbox.toastBulkLater: {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} queued in Answer Later.
ohbox.toastBulkAside: {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} parked.
ohbox.toastBulkResurface: {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} resurface {when}.
ohbox.toastBulkMovedSenders: Mail from {senders, plural, one {1 sender} other {# senders}} now goes to {place} — {count, plural, =0 {nothing needed moving} one {1 message moved} other {# messages moved}}.
ohbox.toastBulkMoveFailed: Nothing moved — that change could not be saved. Try it again.
ohbox.toastBulkMovedPlain: {place} — {count, plural, one {1 message} other {# messages}} moved.
ohbox.sentNote: Your recent sent mail is included above. Older sent mail stays on your server — find it in Search.

whyRefused.nobody: Nothing organizes this mailbox, so a change made here is not carried out. Settings → Mailboxes has the button to organize it here.
whyRefused.starting: Organizing here starts on its next pass — within a minute. Changes can be made once it has.
whyRefused.outdated: {name} organizes this mailbox, and its version of ohmail can't take this change from here. Make it there, or update ohmail on it.
whyRefused.outdatedUnknown: The install that organizes this mailbox can't take this change from here. Make it there, or update ohmail on it.
whyRefused.elsewhere: {name} organizes this mailbox, so this change is made there.
whyRefused.elsewhereUnknown: Another ohmail install organizes this mailbox, so this change is made there.

row.marks: {count} messages, oldest first: {unread, plural, =0 {all read} other {# unread}}

bar.label: Selection
bar.screenConfirm: {senders, plural, one {1 sender} other {# senders}} → {place}. {count, plural, one {1 message moves} other {# messages move}}. No rule is made, so future mail is unchanged.
bar.screenConfirmRules: {senders, plural, one {1 sender} other {# senders}} → {place}. {count, plural, one {1 message moves} other {# messages move}}, and {rules, plural, one {1 of them is still waiting, so this becomes a rule for their future mail} other {# of them are still waiting, so this becomes a rule for their future mail}}. There is no undo.
bar.screenNothing: That mail is already in {place}. Nothing would move and no rule would be made.
